name: Dumbbell Supine Serratus Punch
steps: Lie flat on your back on a mat with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a light dumbbell in your hand with your arm extended straight up toward the ceiling over your shoulder.
Keeping your elbow completely locked and straight, punch the dumbbell directly upward toward the ceiling by lifting your shoulder blade off the floor.
Hold the peak protraction for one full second, feeling the muscle along your side ribs engage.
Slowly retract your shoulder blade, pulling it back flat against the mat without bending your elbow.
coaching_cues: The elbow must stay straight; all motion occurs strictly from protracting and retracting your shoulder blade.
Push directly straight up toward the ceiling, not backward over your head.
Breathe out as you punch upward and breathe in as you lower.
